title: The section action through completed ordinary pushforward
statement: For a prime l, a scheme morphism f : X to S, a completed realization eS of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference], a completed module M on X and a pro-etale object U over S, regard the underlying comparison eS.underlying at the completed pushforward of M as a map to ordinary abelian direct image. This map carries the internal section action of the normalized image of a completed coefficient c to the action of completedPushScalar f U c of [lem-sfb-diagonal-completed-scalar-push] on the resulting section of M over the pullback of U. The comparison is heterogeneously equal to the prescribed underlying comparison map.

source.place: paragraph (1), coefficient identification; underlying pushforward part of lem-diagonal-completed-ordinary-square

proof.text: The underlying abelian sheaf of completed ringed direct image is ordinary abelian direct image. Regard eS.underlying as an isomorphism with that target; its homogeneous components give exactly the original map, so their heterogeneous equality is reflexivity.

Apply the single-site realization action identity to the pushed module and the image of the given section under eS.underlying. Apply eS.underlying.hom and cancel its inverse. The completed pushforward action is restriction of scalars: its coefficient map applied to c multiplies the original section, and its action on one is completedPushScalar. Associativity and multiplication by one give the claimed action.

theorem completedPushInputIso_section_action {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (eS : CompletedRealization l S)
    (M : DiagonalCompleted l X) (U : S.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (c : (Scheme.purTwistRing S (Scheme.purTwistZlCompletion S l)).obj.obj U)
    (x : (eS.F.obj ((diagonalTracePush l f).obj M)).X.obj.obj U) :
    completedPushInputSection f eS M U
        (coefficientSectionAction (eS.F.obj ((diagonalTracePush l f).obj M)) U
          (completedRealizationScalarSection eS U c) x) =
      completedPushScalar f U c • completedPushInputSection f eS M U x
